title: pm(dispatch-gates): changedPathsFromGit reads paths without -z, so a non-ASCII governed path is missed at dispatch
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (a defect found by at-tier review of PR #33804, records 6893545108 and 6893808803, outside that PR's surface).

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` `changedPathsFromGit` (it feeds `--tier` and `--commands`) lists changed paths without `-z`, and nothing sets `core.quotePath=false`. Git prints a path with a non-ASCII or control character C-quoted (`"skills/x/\346\226\207.md"`), which matches no prefix, so a dispatch tier or a derived gate list can miss a governed or gated path. The landing gates now read such paths right (PR #33804), so this is a dispatch-time hole, not a landing hole.

## What lands
- `changedPathsFromGit` reads with `-z` and splits on NUL, like `enumerateRows` after PR #33804; a real-git self-test row with a non-ASCII path under `skills/**` proves the tier and the derived gate list include it; an ablation reddens it.

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` and its self-test; `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`. Ungoverned. Grading is triage's.
